name: Tojil
description: Star of 6,000 K, 318 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: WASP-22 b crosses Tojil as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.

quotes.title: WASP-22
quotes.card: WASP-22, also named Tojil, is a G-type main-sequence star about 1,030 light-years away in the constellation Eridanus.
quotes.introduction: With an apparent magnitude of 12, it is much too faint to be visible to the naked eye.
